def ledger(ops: list[str]) -> tuple[dict[str, int], list[int]]:
    balances = {}
    frozen = set()
    history = []
    rejected = []

    for index, operation in enumerate(ops):
        tokens = operation.split(" ")
        if any(not token for token in tokens):
            rejected.append(index)
            continue

        verb = tokens[0]

        if verb == "undo" and len(tokens) == 1:
            if not history:
                rejected.append(index)
                continue

            for account, old_balance, was_frozen in history.pop():
                if old_balance is None:
                    del balances[account]
                    frozen.discard(account)
                else:
                    balances[account] = old_balance
                    if was_frozen:
                        frozen.add(account)
                    else:
                        frozen.discard(account)
            continue

        if verb in ("freeze", "unfreeze") and len(tokens) == 2:
            account = tokens[1]
            if account not in balances or ((account in frozen) == (verb == "freeze")):
                rejected.append(index)
                continue

            history.append([(account, balances[account], account in frozen)])
            if verb == "freeze":
                frozen.add(account)
            else:
                frozen.remove(account)
            continue

        expected_length = 4 if verb == "transfer" else 3
        if verb not in ("open", "deposit", "withdraw", "transfer") or len(tokens) != expected_length:
            rejected.append(index)
            continue

        amount_text = tokens[-1]
        if any(char < "0" or char > "9" for char in amount_text):
            rejected.append(index)
            continue

        # Parse in small chunks so arbitrarily long amounts also work on
        # Python versions that limit decimal string-to-integer conversion.
        amount = 0
        for start in range(0, len(amount_text), 9):
            chunk = amount_text[start:start + 9]
            amount = amount * (10 ** len(chunk)) + int(chunk)

        account = tokens[1]

        if verb == "open":
            if account in balances:
                rejected.append(index)
                continue
            history.append([(account, None, False)])
            balances[account] = amount

        elif verb == "deposit":
            if amount == 0 or account not in balances:
                rejected.append(index)
                continue
            history.append([(account, balances[account], account in frozen)])
            balances[account] += amount

        elif verb == "withdraw":
            if (amount == 0 or account not in balances or account in frozen
                    or balances[account] < amount):
                rejected.append(index)
                continue
            history.append([(account, balances[account], False)])
            balances[account] -= amount

        else:
            destination = tokens[2]
            if (amount == 0 or account == destination or account not in balances
                    or destination not in balances or account in frozen
                    or balances[account] < amount):
                rejected.append(index)
                continue
            history.append([
                (account, balances[account], False),
                (destination, balances[destination], destination in frozen),
            ])
            balances[account] -= amount
            balances[destination] += amount

    return balances, rejected
